profile.name: Catherine Vance
profile.summary: Operations executive with 18 years in industrial manufacturing, the last seven running multi-plant operations of up to 1,400 people. I turn around underperforming plants, build leadership teams that stay, and connect the shop floor to the numbers the board cares about. Most recently led a $40 million modernization that raised on-time delivery from 81% to 96%.

descriptions: Lead three plants and two distribution centers with 1,400 employees and a $310 million operating budget, reporting to the CEO
Planned and delivered a $40 million modernization across all three plants on schedule and $2.3 million under budget
Raised on-time delivery from 81% to 96% and cut warranty claims by 38% over four years
Brought the recordable injury rate from 4.1 to 1.6 by putting safety walks and near-miss reporting at the center of every plant meeting
Rebuilt the plant leadership team, and every manager hired since 2020 has stayed
Integrated an acquired valve business into our operating system in nine months, keeping every major customer and all of its 120 employees
Ran a 600-person plant making hydraulic components for construction equipment, with annual output of about $140 million
Turned the plant from a $6 million loss to a $9 million profit in three years through lean projects, a new shift pattern and better scrap control
Negotiated two labor agreements with no strikes and half the grievances
Opened a second assembly line for a new product in 11 months, ahead of plan
Introduced tiered daily meetings from the shop floor to the plant staff, so problems reached the right level within a day
Managed production, maintenance and quality for a 220-person tooling plant
Introduced daily production boards and a weekly cost review that cut overtime by 30%
Led the plant's first ISO 9001 certification, passed with no major findings
Moved maintenance to a planned schedule and cut unplanned downtime by 25%
Hired and trained the plant's first team of production supervisors drawn from the shop floor
Set up a cross-trained maintenance crew that covered all three shifts
Cut scrap from 4.8% to 2.1% of material cost with operator-led problem solving
Ran the plant's capital budget of about $3 million a year
Worked with sales on quoting rules that ended money-losing rush orders
Redesigned two assembly cells, raising output per labor hour by 22%
Built the plant's standard cost model, still in use when I left
Ran time studies and line balancing for a new product launch with the engineering team
